lessons.title: Lessons (newest first, keep under 30 lines; prune stale ones)
items: 2026-11-22: Outage skipped the 11/19 avoid review; 43/46 avoids lapsed silently. Set until = review day + >=1 routine day buffer, never on weekend/holiday; pre-market flags avoids expiring in 1 day without a logged review. (reviews/avoid_review_2026-11-22.md)
2026-11-13: Week 11/9–13: 1 up / 3 down / 1 void, avg −0.70% per call vs SPY +0.04%. Upgrade-only longs (SAP, PANW) lagged; COST special-div +1.7%. Paper swing −0.4% vs bench +2.6% on the week.
2026-11-13: Two-week MTM on 11/5–6 non-tech beat-and-raise holds: HUM +8.4%, PLNT +5.4%, CPAY +3.4%, CAH +2.4%. Beat-and-raise drift beats upgrade pops; favor it.
2026-11-13: Upgrade-only pre-market pops (PANW +3.5% pre → −2.9% from open) fade. Log upgrade ideas at the close, not the open.
2026-11-13: The conditional AH-gain rule saved us on CSCO (gain failed, −6.2% next day). Keep conditional entries for AH beats.

RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-11-23)
Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and the AI trade roared back: NVDA +31%, Nasdaq +6.5%, S&P +4.7%, Dow +3.0%, the best day since April 2025, a session after all three closed in correction.
CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in a ~$44B all-stock deal; ZS jumped and CRWD fell, and both stay on our avoid list.
Our call to hold the AI-hardware avoid missed today's squeeze, by design: we don't chase >5% gaps the session after a sector shock. Non-tech holds were mixed: TGT +1.5%, TJX -0.4%.
After the bell, HPE beat and guided FY27 well above estimates but slipped ~2% in extended trade; Agilent beat on EPS and sales.
Next up: consumer confidence plus DELL/HPQ/WDAY/ADSK tomorrow, then PCE, GDP and claims Wednesday with a December hike ~96% priced. A hot PCE is the main risk to this bounce.
